label: Bible Study
prompt: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In _____ and offerings.
verse: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.
note: Malachi's pointed question — the people asked 'how?' and got a four-word answer.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The _____ appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
verse: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
note: Winter's over, flowers are up, the birds are singing — the Bible's prettiest spring morning.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded _____.
verse: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
note: Overnight, Aaron's dead walking stick budded, bloomed, and produced almonds — case closed on who God had chosen.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is _____?
verse: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
note: Samson's father asked the angel's name and was refused — then the angel rose up in the altar's flame.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not _____ their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
verse: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
note: God was in Christ reconciling the world, 'not imputing' — not charging — their trespasses unto them.
